nodes.name: Create Gmail DRAFT (review first)
nodes.notes: SAFE MODE: creates a draft you review before sending. To auto-send, change resource to 'message' and operation to 'send' — but ONLY from a warmed, authenticated domain inbox, throttled, to Oy/Oyj recipients, with opt-out. See DELIVERABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md.

_README: Import into n8n (Workflows → Import from File). Set credentials: Gmail OAuth2, and env GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY. Google Places does NOT return email addresses — add an email-enrichment step (scrape the website's contact page or use a verifier) before the Gmail node. DEFAULT is DRAFT mode for legal + deliverability safety. Do not auto-send 100 cold emails/day from a personal Gmail — read DELIVERABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md first.
